findings: Original PCA and t-SNE compiled unchanged with original thread helpers. Rank-one PCA gives unit explained variance and correct endpoint distance. Deterministic32x64 binary features produce identical PCA and12-iteration t-SNE coordinates under1/4 threads, all tested t-SNE coordinates finite. Thread parity does not establish mathematical correctness.

Jacobi eigen solver stops after200 single-pivot rotations with no convergence status. Independent Av-lambda*v residual over original centered Gram matrix reaches1.88856 on deterministic32x64 data; unqualified principal-coordinate accuracy is not justified.

Eight identical feature vectors remain all-zero through20 t-SNE iterations because initialization and every displacement are zero. This is a degenerate input result, not evidence of general t-SNE convergence.

Feature parser silently zero-pads missing hexadecimal bits: a and a0 both yield identical eight-bit features, empty hash yields zero vector. Invalid hex sscanf result is unchecked; malformed text not executed.

PCA clamps output dimensions to min(requested,samples,features), t-SNE allocates gradient by requested dimensions but initializes coordinates with clamped PCA dimensions. Requested dimensions exceeding available PCA coordinates can cause unchecked access; source only, not executed.
Ragged feature rows and nonfinite parameters lack local validation. Pairwise matrices require quadratic storage; no resource-admission benchmark performed.
remaining: Full CLI and UI qualification, real video decoding and independent wavelet/t-SNE oracle
